title: Agent Company
subtitle: Organise agents into a multi-tier company, set its rules, and design one from a description.
desktopOnly: The agent company is only available in the desktop app.

sider.title: Companies
sider.chatOpenError: Could not open the chat for this role.
sider.chatNoExecutor: This role has no runnable agent assigned yet.

picker.title: Companies
picker.subtitle: Pick a company to manage, or create a new one.
picker.empty: No companies yet. Create one from a description below.
picker.deleteConfirmContent: Permanently remove "{{companyId}}" — its rules, structure, and remembered chats. This cannot be undone.
picker.deletePartial: Removed "{{companyId}}" from the list, but the backend was unavailable so its files may remain.

describe.title: Create from a description
describe.subtitle: Describe your project or goal and let Omni design a fitting role chart.
describe.placeholder: Describe the project or goal. For example: build a cross-platform note app with a polished UI, a sync backend, and automated tests.
describe.error: Could not create the company from that description.
describe.notWired: Designing a company from text needs the agent generator, which is not wired up yet.
describe.strengthsPlaceholder: Tell the designer which tools or assistants are strong at what, e.g. "Claude Code is best for refactors; the research assistant handles web lookups". Reused for every company.

progress.waiting: Waiting for the model — this can take a moment.

describe.tabSwitchHint: Generation runs in the background — you can switch tabs and come back.

structure.title: Role structure
structure.subtitle: The elastic role tree built for this company.
structure.empty: No roles yet. Create this company from a description to generate its structure.
structure.loadError: Could not load the role structure. The company service may not be running yet.
structure.poweredByTip: Every agent in this company runs through your configured model.

assignment.modelCliManagedHint: This CLI uses its own configured model — set it in the CLI's settings.
assignment.draftBanner: The designer proposed {{count}} new assistant(s) for roles with no match.
assignment.acceptError: Could not create the draft assistants.
assignment.pickMcpPlaceholder: Grant MCP servers this role may use (e.g. browser, office)
assignment.modeHint: Higher modes (e.g. YOLO / full access) let the agent act without asking — grant only when the role needs it.

editor.title: Edit company structure
editor.noDivisions: No divisions yet. Add one, or leave empty for a flat company.

rules.title: Company rules
rules.subtitle: Rules every agent must follow, for example: every plan must be reviewed by the System Architect.
rules.empty: No rules yet. Add the first one below.

conversation.goalPlaceholder: Describe what the company should do, e.g. "Draft a launch plan for the new mobile app and split the work across the team."
conversation.startHint: The President will brief the team and delegate.
conversation.boardEmpty: Start a conversation to see who is talking to whom and who is doing what.
conversation.transcriptEmpty: The dialogue between the President and the team will appear here.

pipeline.modePipelineHint: Roles run their assigned CLI/assistant for real — reading and writing files in a workspace.
pipeline.modeConversationHint: A fast preview where roles only talk; no files are changed.
pipeline.startHint: The President delegates down the tree; assigned agents do the real work.
pipeline.boardEmpty: Start a run to see the company tree work, level by level.
pipeline.artifactsEmpty: Documents, reports, and code changes will appear here as roles produce them.
